meta.name: caveman-compress
meta.description: Compress natural language memory files (CLAUDE.md, todos, preferences) into caveman format to save input tokens. Preserves all technical substance, code, URLs, and structure. Compressed version overwrites the original file. Human-readable backup saved as FILE.original.md. Trigger: /caveman-compress FILEPATH or "compress memory file"

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把长记忆文件压成精简格式，节省大模型输入额度
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想给 AI 助手省些对话额度又不丢关键信息
copy.tagline_en: Condense memory files into a lean format to save AI input budget
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to trim AI context costs without losing key details

howto.what: 装上后,Claude会把自然语言记忆文件(如CLAUDE.md、待办)改成简短电报式,保留代码、链接、标题等原样,覆盖原文件,备份原件到独立数据目录。
howto.when: 当你说出“/caveman-compress 文件路径”或要求“压缩记忆文件”时触发。

say.note: 脚本运行后覆盖原文件,备份存到数据目录

say.text: 把待办清单压缩成 caveman 格式
say.note: 代码和原有结构保持不变

say.text: 压缩我的偏好文件,保留原版备份
say.note: 原文件备份在独立数据目录中

howto.what_en: Claude compresses natural-language memory files (CLAUDE.md, todos, etc.) into terse caveman-style text to save tokens. Code, URLs, headings, and structure are preserved exactly. Compressed version overwrites original; backup stored separately in data dir.
howto.when_en: Triggered by "/caveman-compress <filepath>" or when you ask to compress a memory file.

say_en.text: Turn my todos into caveman format
Compress preferences and keep a backup
say_en.note: Backup stored in separate data dir
